order.why: strong parameters are per controller; one controller that forgot permits everything
order.oracle: an undeclared field persisted, traced to the controller

order.why: ActiveRecord scopes apply to queries but a lazy relation can bypass the scope chain
order.oracle: a record reachable through a lazy path that the collection query excludes

order.why: authorisation usually lives in a before_action per controller, so gaps are per controller too
order.oracle: a request replayed as a lower role that still succeeds

order.why: ActiveStorage and blob uploads decide type by content, and the pipeline trusts it
order.oracle: an uploaded file reachable and interpreted as something else

order.why: counter caches and optimistic locking are where Rails logic races live
order.oracle: a stale write accepted after a concurrent update

order.why: before writing anything up, falsify it
